ModMetaData.name: CE Overpenetration
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiverMa
ModMetaData.description:
Adds generic overpenetration (bullets passing through pawns) to Combat Extended. Eligible ballistic sharp projectiles continue automatically after a successful armor result, with CE-native damage and penetration reduced through retained velocity. No per-ammunition configuration is required.
Breaching AI fixes have been split into CE Breaching Fix. Elite combat stat tuning has been split into CE Elite Combat Tweaks.
Requires Combat Extended.
